messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses"
set: ["this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses", "dose is given in 3 divided doses", "given in divided doses", "taken in divided doses", "this amount corresponds to one or two 50 mg tablets", "this recommendation includes cisplatin doses of 50 mg/m2 or greater", "take immediate release tablets in divided doses 2 to 3 times a day with meals", "total daily doses above 50 mg are not recommended", "daily dose divided into three equal doses", "common starting dose is one 50 mg tablet a day", "taking two 7 mg tablets to achieve 14 mg dose is not recommended", "includes cisplatin doses of 50 mg/m2 or greater", "given as two divided doses up to the same maximum 37.5 mg daily limit", "daily dosage may be divided into two doses per day", "injection formulation diluted in 50 mL", "target dose is equivalent to one 50 mg tablet four times a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
